messages:
marta: Quick accessibility bug: VoiceOver skips the first parameter in the invoke panel and lands on the close button. Repro on macOS Safari.
ryan: thanks for flagging. sounds like DOM order vs visual layout. can you paste repro steps?
marta: steps: open playground -> choose fn -> click Invoke -> VO+RightArrow. focus goes to close instead of first input.
samir: probable cause: close button gets focusable before param rows. quick fix: tabindex=-1 on close and manage focus when panel opens.
olivia: UX/copy mismatch: we use 'Run' in run history and 'Invoke' in the panel. confusing for screen reader users. propose we standardize on 'Invoke' in the playground.
ryan: agree on standardization. avoid tooltip-only clarifications. keep visible label = accessible name.
marta: also run-history badges have low contrast in dark mode (AA fail). token tweak suggested: #245a9a.
samir: will update theme token and add aria-hidden sr-only span for variant name in summaries so SR users hear the variant without expanding.
olivia: add aria-live feedback for 'Copy to prompt' action: "Copied parameters to prompt" so SR users get confirmation.
ryan: can we add a tiny VoiceOver smoke test to CI for this path? basic flow: open panel -> focus first param -> submit -> history updated.
samir: i can add an e2e on macos runner and include a short screencast.
devex-bot: created issue DEVEX-2077 "Invoke panel: VO focus order, label consistency, and contrast fixes" -> https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-2077
marta: thanks. i'll validate VO after the PR. :thumbsup:
ryan: timeline: keep it minimal 1 aria attributes, copy, and token tweak. aim for patch this week.
